data.long_meaning: In the South African language Xitsonga, Mpho means 'gift of God'. This beautiful and meaningful name is popular among Christian communities. The name Mpho carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Xitsonga. Parents who choose Mpho usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mpho belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”

in_english.name: Mpho
in_english.long_meaning: Mpho is a gift of knowledge and perception. It is a name that represents the ability to understand and respond to the world around us. In Christian tradition, Mpho is associated with the gift of knowledge and perception. The name Mpho is derived from the Setswana language and means 'gift' or 'something received'. In a spiritual context, Mpho represents the ability to receive and understand God's word. The name Mpho is also associated with the qualities of intelligence, wisdom, and discernment. It is a name that is rich in meaning and significance, and is often given to children born into Christian families.
